session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Spike to Complex Bear Flag becomes Endless Pullback'. Small gap up at the open then bear trend from the open: opening bear spike (09:45) down to a failed bear breakout of yesterday's low (10:00 low 7390, Leg 1 = Leg 2 tight bear channel sell vacuum test of support), then rebound into a bear trending trading range the rest of the day: wedge bear flag, MM upper range double top (12:20 high 7460), second upper range double top (14:30), multiple double bottoms (15:30 low 7408) and close 7438.25 near the 7427.88 EMA.
